settingsSections.label: Instructions
settingsSections.description: Ready-to-use guidance for each kind of work. Customize behavior and linked notes.

settingsSections.label: Voice Provider
settingsSections.description: Speech provider, voice and conversation mode.

settingsSections.label: Projects
settingsSections.description: Working folders and shared instructions for projects.

settingsSections.label: Telegram
settingsSections.description: Talk to the assistant from outside the app over Telegram. Add one connection per bot; each carries its own token, allow-list, instructions, router and commands. The app must be open to handle messages.

settingsSections.label: WhatsApp
settingsSections.description: Talk to the assistant from outside the app over an official WhatsApp Business Platform / Cloud API number — no Twilio, no WhatsApp Web bridge, no managed tunnel. The app must be open to handle messages.

presets.label: Recommended
presets.description: Reads are free; file writes, deletes and command runs confirm. Secrets are always blocked.

presets.label: Read-only
presets.description: The assistant can read and answer, but never write or run commands.

fields.label: Attachment folder
fields.description: Where files you attach in a chat are saved in the vault
